segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: First of all I'd just like to say, Cristina and Ibrahim, that I really enjoyed watching your video about student life last week, and I could see that the rest of the group did too. You did really well, and I hope that you got a lot out of it. I'd like to use this tutorial as a feedback session, where you reflect on the experience of doing the project. So Cristina, I was wondering, what did you enjoy most about making the video?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: I liked using the camera.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Is it the first time you've operated one like that?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: Yes, it is.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well the results were very good! Anything else?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: I also enjoyed visiting one of the British students we filmed. I'd never been inside a British ~ before.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: OK Cristina, thanks. What about you, Ibrahim? What did you enjoy?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: Well for me it was a very good chance to get to know students who are on other courses, because everyone in our group is studying English, and we don't usually have much to do with the rest of the college.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, good. Do you think you'll maintain the contact now?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: I hope so. I've invited three of them to have dinner with me next week.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Great! If you haven't decided what to make yet I can tell you they'll love trying Arab dishes. And of course, it's good for your English too. Cristina, · what did you find? What was the most useful aspect of the project from the point of view of the English practice?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: I think, when we were being shown how to edit the film, we had to follow the instructions. And that was very good practice for me. And I also learned some technical words that I hadn't heard before.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: What about you Ibrahim? What was the most useful for your English?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: It was listening to the British students, because they don't speak as slowly as most of the tutors on our course. I think they speak at natural speed, so it forces me to get used to it. And they use a lot of slang.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: So you learned some new words which will be useful?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Good. I'm glad it helped. Well, we've talked a little bit about enjoyment, and about language practice. Were there any other benefits? What else did you feel you'd learnt from the project? Was it useful in other ways?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: Yes, well firstly, I learned how to use a video camera. And also, I think I really learned a lot about working together with other people. I've never done anything with a group before, and we had to find ways of cooperating, erm, and compromising, and sometimes persuading people, when they don't agree with you.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Yes, that is a very useful experience, I know.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: What about you, Ibrahim?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: Well, I think I learnt a lot about how important editing is. When you're filming you think that everything's going to be interesting, but in fact we cut around half of it in the end, and then it was much better.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Good. Well, one last thing I'd like to ask. What mistakes do you think you, as a group that is, made? I mean, to put it another way, if you had to do it all over again, is there anything you'd do differently?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: We didn't plan very well. For , we didn't decide on dates when we'd complete each separate step of the project, and we should have agreed about that in the beginning, because we were always late with everything!

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Right. Anything else?

segments.speaker: CRISTINA
segments.en: I think we should have tried to experiment more with the camera. I mean with angles, and the focus and that kind of thing.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: So you should have beer:t more ambitious? Do you agree, Ibrahim?

segments.speaker: IBRAHIM
segments.en: Not really. In fact, I think we were too ambitious. We were inexperienced, and we didn't have a lot of time, and we tried to do too much, to make a long film. Next time I would make a shorter one and try to get the quality better.

segments.speaker: TUTOR
segments.en: Well, that's very interesting. Next semester we will be doing another video project- with a different content, of course - but you'll have an opportunity to put into practice what you've learnt this time. Do you have any ideas about . . .
